am.regex_vide: Give at least one regular expression in `valeur` (several: separate them with `;;`).
am.regex_max: 10 regular expressions at most per rule (Discord limit).
am.regex_longue: Each expression must be 260 characters at most (Discord limit).
am.regex_rust: The expression `{motif}` uses a syntax Discord does not support (lookahead, lookbehind or backreference).
am.regex_vide_match: The expression `{motif}` matches empty text: it would block every message.
am.niveau_requis: Pick the level in the `niveau` option (souple, normal or strict).
am.preset_echec: • **{nom}**: refused by Discord (rule limit reached or invalid setting)
am.exempt_rien: Give a role, a channel or `jeux:True`.
am.exempt_everyone: The @everyone role cannot be exempted: nobody would be checked anymore.
am.exempt_aucune_regle: No AutoMod rule created by the bot: create a rule or a preset first.
am.exempt_limite_roles: Discord limit exceeded: 20 exempt roles at most per rule (rule **{nom}**). Nothing was changed.
am.exempt_limite_salons: Discord limit exceeded: 50 exempt channels at most per rule (rule **{nom}**). Nothing was changed.
am.exempt_jeux_aucun: No game channel is configured on this server (see /config).
am.exempt_inchange: Nothing to change: the exemptions were already up to date.
am.exempt_refuse: Discord refused to change a rule.
am.exempt_pied: -# Administrators and members with "Manage Server" are never checked by AutoMod.
am.dossiers_on: AutoMod blocks count as warnings: the `/sanctions` thresholds apply.
am.dossiers_off: AutoMod blocks are only recorded in the history, without a warning.
am.dossiers_active: Enabled: each AutoMod block creates a warning (at most one per member per minute) and can trigger the `/sanctions` thresholds.
am.dossiers_coupe: Disabled: AutoMod blocks are recorded in the history, without a warning.
am.dossiers_pouvoir: You don't have the permission to apply the sanction set at {warns} warns yourself, so I won't apply it on your behalf.
